topic: huashu-motion: an open-source alternative to Claude Motion (Claude's Team/Enterprise-only motion beta)

facts.claude_motion: Claude Motion is in beta on Team and Enterprise plans (Anthropic announcement, Oct 8 2026: 'Build live dashboards and animate explainers with Claude'). Plate: shared/shots/claude-motion-article.png
facts.claude_plans: Claude plans: Free, Pro, Max, Team, Enterprise. Plate: shared/shots/claude-pricing.png
facts.huashu_repo: github.com/alchaincyf/huashu-motion - MIT license, ~1.4k stars, 139 forks, v0.3.1, tagline 'Commercial-grade product launch films, in one go.' Install: npx skills add alchaincyf/huashu-motion
facts.huashu_stack: Films are HTML/CSS/JavaScript (GSAP) rendered in Chrome; adds transitions + a music score ('Score first, then the picture'); has a browser editor ('Point at the frame': press C, click the frame, type the change)
facts.hyperframes: github.com/heygen-com/hyperframes - HeyGen's open-source HTML-to-video framework. Chase ran both on the same brief; huashu-motion's film did a little better on product demos.
facts.not_used: No AI video generators: not Kling (Kuaishou), not Seedance (ByteDance).
